verses.ar:
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ
يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمْ
verses.tr:
Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammad
Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalayhi wa sallim
verses.en:
O Allah send blessings upon Muhammad
O Lord, send peace upon him

verses.ar:
فِي حُبِّ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدْ
نُورٌ لِبَدْرِ الْهُدَى مُتَمَّمْ
قَلْبِي يَحِنُّ إِلَى مُحَمَّدْ
مَا زَالَ مِنْ وُجْدِهِ مُتَيَّمْ
verses.tr:
Fī ḥubbi sayyidinā Muḥammad
Nūrun li-badri-l-hudā mutammam
Qalbī yaḥinnu ilā Muḥammad
Mā zāla min wujdihi mutayyam
verses.en:
In the love of our beloved master Muhammad
Who is the full moon of guidance
My heart is filled with the compassion for Muhammad
It is still filled with intense longing for him

verses.ar:
مَا لِي حَبِيبٌ سِوَى مُحَمَّدْ
خَيْرَ الرَّسُولِ النَّبِيِّ الْمُكَرَّمْ
شَوْقُ الْمُحِبِّ إِلَى مُحَمَّدْ
أَفْنَاهُ ثُمَّ بِهِ تَهَيَّمْ
verses.tr:
Mā lī ḥabībun siwā Muḥammad
Khayra-r-rasūli-n-nabiyyi-l-mukarram
Shawqu-l-muḥibbi ilā Muḥammad
Afnāhu thumma bihi tahayyam
verses.en:
I have no beloved but Muhammad
The best of messengers, the honoured Prophet
The follower’s wish is nothing but Muhammad
He is consumed in him and lost in his love

verses.ar:
فِي الْحَشْرِ شَافِعُنَا مُحَمَّدْ
مُنْجِي الْخَلَائِقِ مِنْ جَهَنَّمْ
مِيلَادُ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدْ
أُمُّ الْقُرَى بَلَدٌ مُعَظَّمْ
verses.tr:
Fi-l-ḥashri shāfiʿunā Muḥammad
Munji-l-khalāʾiqi min jahannam
Mīlādu sayyidinā Muḥammad
Ummu-l-qurā baladun muʿaẓẓam
verses.en:
On the Day of Judgement, our intercessor is Muhammad
He is the rescuer of humans from hell-fire (by the Mercy of Allah)
The birth of our master Muhammad and his coming in this world! (What an event, all praise is due to his Creator!)
The mother of cities is his glorious city

verses.ar:
أَحْيَا الدُّجَى زَمَنًا مُحَمَّدْ
مَوْلَاهُ سَلَّمَهُ وَكَلَّمْ
أَدْعُوكَ أَحْمَدُ يَا مُحَمَّدْ
يَا سَيِّدَ الرُّسُلِ الْمُقَدَّمْ
verses.tr:
Aḥya-d-dujā zamanan Muḥammad
Mawlāhu sallamahu wa kallam
Adʿūka Aḥmadu yā Muḥammad
Yā sayyida-r-rusuli-l-muqaddam
verses.en:
Muhammad kept the dark nights alive in prayer for a time
His Lord greeted him with peace and spoke to him
I call upon you, O Aḥmad, O Muhammad
O master of the messengers, the foremost

verses.ar:
اِشْفَعْ إِلَى اللّٰهِ يَا مُحَمَّدْ
يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَيْ أُنَعَّمْ
أَرْجُو الشَّفَاعَةَ مِنْ مُحَمَّدْ
لَوْ كُنْتُ أَرْتَكِبُ الْمُحَرَّمْ
verses.tr:
Ishfaʿ ila-llāhi yā Muḥammad
Yawma-l-qiyāmati kay unaʿʿam
Arju-sh-shafāʿata min Muḥammad
Law kuntu artakibu-l-muḥarram
verses.en:
Intercede with Allah, O Muhammad
On the Day of Resurrection, that I may be blessed
I hope for intercession from Muhammad
Even had I committed what is forbidden

verses.ar:
مَنْجًا وَمَلْجَاءُ نَا مُحَمَّدْ
يَوْمَ الْهَوَانِ بِهِ تَحَشَّمْ
وَالنُّورُ جَاءَ بِهِ مُحَمَّدْ
وَالْحَقُّ بَيَّنَ وَإِنْ تَكَلَّمْ
verses.tr:
Manjan wa maljāʾunā Muḥammad
Yawma-l-hawāni bihi taḥashsham
Wa-n-nūru jāʾa bihi Muḥammad
Wa-l-ḥaqqu bayyana wa in takallam
verses.en:
Muhammad is our rescue and our refuge
On the Day of Disgrace, through him we keep our honour
Muhammad brought the light with him
The truth manifested when he talked

verses.ar:
أَعْلَى السَّمَاءِ سَمَا مُحَمَّدْ
جِبْرِيلُ قَالَ لَهُ تَقَدَّمْ
وَالْجُنْدُ حِينَ غَزَا مُحَمَّدْ
مِنْهُمْ مَلَائِكَةٌ تَسَوَّمْ
verses.tr:
Aʿla-s-samāʾi samā Muḥammad
Jibrīlu qāla lahu taqaddam
Wa-l-jundu ḥīna ghazā Muḥammad
Minhum malāʾikatun tasawwam
verses.en:
To the highest heaven Muhammad ascended
Jibrīl said to him: Go forward
And the army, when Muhammad went out to battle
Among them were angels bearing their marks

verses.ar:
وَالدِّينَ أَظْهَرَهُ مُحَمَّدْ
وَالْكُفْرَ أَبْطَلَهُ فَهَدَّمْ
verses.tr:
Wa-d-dīna aẓharahu Muḥammad
Wa-l-kufra abṭalahu fa-haddam
verses.en:
Muhammad made the religion prevail
He brought unbelief to nothing and tore it down

verses.ar:
صَلَّى الْإِلَهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ
وَالْآلِ كُلِّهِمِ وَسَلَّمْ
وَصَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ
وَعَلٰى صَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمْ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
Ṣalla-l-ilāhu ʿalā Muḥammad
Wa-l-āli kullihimi wa sallam
Wa ṣalla-llāhu ʿalā Muḥammad
Wa ʿalā ṣaḥbihi wa sallam
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayh
verses.en:
May God send blessings upon Muhammad
And upon all his family, and grant them peace
And may Allah send blessings upon Muhammad
And upon his companions, and grant them peace
O Allah, send Your blessings, peace and grace upon him
